about_the_game:
Notice: Original Game was not designed to have DLCs, and it remains that way. No extra contents are added via DLC.

However, this DLC exists to quick-unlocks some stuff that can be unlocked by just playing in the game. This is a feature asked by some players that wanted to play with all characters and some specific filters right from start.

Slam and Roll - Freedom DLC contains unlocks:

- All game areas.

- Unlock all visual filters.

- Unlock all characters.

- Unlock all game modes.

Also adds 5 additional credits from the base game to be used in arcade modes.
